a-ayo, audiocrackerr

badi batcheet industry ke logo se
poori picture bachi, abhi promo dekh
mere kisse sunoge toh ro doge
lash curry, khushi, bakchodi ni dono se

bhali-bhaati humein roka tha bohoton ne
parivaar khush, mujhe tum kya hi rokoge
bistar bna denge noto ke
agar mehnat ko paiso se tologe

rukegi kalam ni, jab tak hoon zinda main
marungi tab tak ni, kala hai zinda
mujhe lagta hai, jaanti sab hoon main
haar ya jeet ki hoti ni chinta

main sunti hoon logo ko zyada ni
par, haan, main jaanti, sabke hoon dil ka
mere hote padosi ameer, jo paisa
yaahan baatein banane se milta

lo, aadat daal main rukoon, ye hoga ni
socha ni kisi ni, karungi sab
paiso se laakho ka bharungi pet main
mujhe ni kamana bharne ko ghar

phele bhi bola hai, "maqsad ni hai mera
kamana paisa ya kamana fame"
faraq hai mujhe, badalni hai duniya
aur tumhe badalne hain ghar

karne se baatein ho jati hain taaza
wo yaadein ki kaise kara maine shuru tha tab
koi ni tha mere sath mein rone ko
aaiyne mein baitha guru tha bass

kehte the log, "tere bass ki ni tha"
mera dil bhi naadan tha, maanta sach
"par kuch ni hai aisa, jo tu ni kar sakti"
ab kehta hai aaiyna, kehte hain sab

sangeet ko sab kiya samarpit
likhe dill se, gaane hain mere ameer geet
biggie, pac ko sun gaya safar beet
meri baatein hain raw, no more color grid

meri maa se puchhna mere baare me
baap se ladi vo, "bete ko gaane de"
saath me khadi, main uske sahare se
to kaise socha tune ki hum haarenge?

kitni dafa main gira, kitni dafa main utha
kitna dafa khuda mein mujhko dua me suna
kabhi ni ruka-jhuka ni, kabhi ni muda-vuda main
kabhi ni kisi ke baare kabhi ni bola bura me

damn, mere aankhon pe patti baandh
mujhe dekhna ni, hate karoon haq ki baat
hum dono banane chale hain legacy
ek beat pe khushi aur...

and the winnner of oho, scene change, season one is khushi!
